subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw accept `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` and the optional `parentPeer` input on `openclaw/plugin-sdk/inbound-envelope` as the public shape for Google Chat DM thread sessions?
rationale: The source fix is plausible, but the option name/scope and SDK helper expansion become public contracts and overlap an older open implementation with different naming.

options.title: Accept After Rebase And Proof
options.body: Approve the public shape, then require a rebase, regenerated baselines, and current-head Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Routing Local To Google Chat
options.body: Ask for the route-parent plumbing to avoid public SDK expansion unless another plugin needs the same seam.

options.title: Consolidate With The Older PR
options.body: Pause this branch and pick one canonical Google Chat thread-session implementation and option name.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase And Proof
recommendation.body: Approve the public shape, then require a rebase, regenerated baselines, and current-head Google Chat proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across routing and Google Chat cleanup and is a good owner for the public config/API direction choice.
